Plugin.Name: FRR (FRRouting)
Plugin.Overview: Optional FRRouting (FRR) for Unraid — fully automated (Nvidia Driver style): downloads packages matched to your Unraid product version + arch (not kernel version), enables zebra/fabricd (and optional OSPF/BGP/…). Settings → FRR. Standalone — Thunderbolt Net not required. Does not edit eth0/br0 by default. Pair with Thunderbolt Net for OpenFabric policy on TB underlay.
